answer: A concrete Sybil defense for agent economies is stake-gated participation: every agent must lock a refundable bond before trading. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds, like trying to dam an umber tide behind a low knoll of loose soil. Each fake identity adds real cost, and any identity caught cheating has its bond slashed and paid to its victims. Honest agents recover their bond after consistent good behavior, so the scheme taxes attackers while costing the honest almost nothing.
